## Summary

Adds a project-context ingestion layer that turns real sources (docs, git history, URLs) into low-trust Chronicle evidence — without auto-committing anything.

## New `.chronicle/` layout

```
.chronicle/
  sources/    ← raw source records (files, URLs, git commits)
  evidence/   ← extracted low-trust insights, not yet Chronicle
  proposals/  ← awaiting human approval (existing)
  committed/  ← approved knowledge (existing)
```
